newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska cattle trade steady on dressed basis-USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska cattle trade steady on dressed basis-USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers not established on a live basis. Demand and seller interest uneven, but generally light.
Dressed Basis Delivered. Steers and heifers steady with Wednesday's close.
Dressed Basis Steers: Select and Choice 2-3 1220-1300 lbs 106.00-108.00; few mainly Choice 109.00 early. Cattle selling at 106.00 in central to Western areas of the state. ( weighted average 106.71 )

Dressed Basis Heifers: Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1200 lbs 106.00-108.00; few mainly Choice 109.00 early. Cattle selling at 106.00 in central to Western areas of the state.( weighted average 106.76 ).
For the week: Slaughter steers and heifers on a live basis 2.00-3.00 lower; dressed basis mostly 5.00-6.00 lower.
Weekly total includes 10,300 formulated and previously contracted cattle. Sales Confirmed:1,200 Last Week: 2,900 Last Year: 8,500 Week To Date: 67,200 Sm Pd Lst Wk:83,700 Sm Pd Lst Yr: 71,600
